title: Recovery completes an interrupted apply, so output and record always agree
given: A project with applied output and a new plan.
when: Apply fails at each journal point in turn, and recover runs.
then: Plan and drift refuse until recovery runs. After recovery the output matches the state record and no drift remains.

title: Drift detection fails when a generated file no longer matches its recorded hash
given: A project with applied output and recorded file hashes.
when: A generated file is edited by hand and drift detection runs.
then: The result names the modified file and reports drift.

title: A state record whose input manifest disagrees with it is refused
given: An applied state record with an input manifest.
when: The service hash or the registry reference in the manifest differs from the applied value.

title: Apply refuses a plan whose registry digest differs from the live registry
given: A plan from a loaded registry.
when: The registry content digest in the plan state is replaced and apply runs.
then: Apply fails with a registry error and writes no output.

title: A changed component generator shows as an update in the next plan
given: A project applied from one component generator output.
when: The component produces new content and plan runs again.
then: The plan marks the generated file as an update.

title: A registry change that does not affect output leaves every generated file unchanged
given: A project with applied output and a recorded registry digest.
when: A comment is added to a component declaration and apply runs.
then: The state record gains the new registry digest. Every generated file stays unchanged.

title: A new generation run restores the generated output without a hand edit
when: A generated file is edited by hand, then plan and apply run.
then: The plan names the file as an update. Apply restores the generated content and leaves no drift.

title: Qualification fails when the release tag does not point at the source commit
given: A qualified source commit and a published release tag.
when: The tag points at another commit and release verification runs.

title: Qualification fails when a required CI job has no success conclusion
given: A complete set of CI runs at the source commit.
when: One required checks job is absent from the job list.

title: Release verification cross-checks every published asset digest and the evidence notes
given: A published immutable release at the qualified commit.
then: It installs the release through the consumer path. It reports the asset digests and confirms that the notes hold the run and the compiler digest.

title: Installation refuses a platform other than Linux amd64 before any download
given: An installation request for a published release.
when: The machine reports aarch64, or the revision is not a full commit, or the result directory exists.
then: Installation fails and makes no API call.

title: Installation verifies both signatures before it puts the binary in place
given: A published release with four assets.
when: Installation downloads and verifies the assets.
then: The compiler and the build record are both authenticated while the result directory does not yet exist. The published bytes then match the downloaded bytes.

title: The version command reports the current build record
then: The record in the output equals the current build identity.

title: Apply writes the current build identity into the service state record
when: Apply runs, and then a changed build record is offered in the plan.
then: The state record holds the current build identity. Apply refuses a substituted record and leaves the state unchanged.
